tickets.title: Charged twice for the monthly plan
tickets.description: Our card was charged twice for the October subscription. Please help us investigate the duplicate payment. Invoice reference INV-2048.

tickets.title: Password reset email never arrives
tickets.description: I requested a reset several times and checked spam, but no email arrived. My account email is the one attached to this ticket.

tickets.title: CSV export stops at 100 rows
tickets.description: The analytics export only contains the first 100 rows although our report has more data. We are using Chrome on Windows.

tickets.title: Update the billing address on our invoice
tickets.description: Our company moved offices. We need the next invoice to show the updated billing address. Please explain what details you need.

tickets.title: Package arrived with a damaged item
tickets.description: The outer package was intact, but the product screen is cracked. Photos and the order number can be provided on request.

tickets.title: Unable to invite a new teammate
tickets.description: The invite button is disabled for our workspace administrator. We have three members and believe our plan includes five seats.

tickets.title: Webhook deliveries are returning 500
tickets.description: Our order.created webhook endpoint has returned HTTP 500 since this morning. We need help checking the integration and recent retries.

tickets.title: Question about moving to an annual plan
tickets.description: We would like to know how an annual subscription affects the next billing date. Please confirm the available options before making a change.

tickets.title: Where can I download previous invoices?
tickets.description: I need to download the invoices from the last three months for our accounting team.
tickets.resolution: Shared the invoice download steps. Customer confirmed the previous invoices are available.

tickets.title: Shipment tracking has not updated
tickets.description: The shipment has shown the same tracking event for two days. Could you check what information is needed to investigate?

tickets.title: Workspace permissions explained
tickets.description: We need to understand the difference between administrator and member permissions.
tickets.resolution: Explained the roles using the permissions guide. Customer confirmed their access works as expected.

tickets.title: Feature request: export in dark mode
tickets.description: Our team uses the dark theme and would like exported report previews to retain that appearance.

articles.title: Troubleshooting password reset emails
articles.content:
Sample support guide

1. Confirm the customer is using the email address associated with their account.
2. Ask them to check spam and filtered folders.
3. Verify the time of the most recent reset request.
4. Escalate delivery failures to the account support team with the email and request time.

Never ask customers to share passwords or reset tokens. This is fictional sample content; adapt it to your product.

articles.title: Investigating a duplicate payment
articles.content:
Sample support guide

Collect the invoice reference, transaction dates, amounts and a redacted payment reference. Check whether either transaction is a pending authorization.

Escalate to the billing team for verification. Do not promise or process a refund without the applicable policy and authorization. Never collect full card numbers.

This example describes an investigation checklist, not a real refund policy.

articles.title: Getting started with workspace roles
articles.content:
Sample product guide

A workspace administrator manages members and workspace settings. A member works with the records they have been granted access to.

When investigating access, record the affected workspace, user email, role and the action that failed. Product permissions vary: replace this fictional guide with the rules for your real product.

articles.title: Collecting useful integration diagnostics
articles.content:
Sample troubleshooting guide

Record the integration event, approximate failure time, HTTP status and a redacted request ID. Ask for the steps to reproduce.

Keep API keys, passwords and access tokens out of tickets. Start with the observed error and verify each suggested fix before marking an issue resolved.
